title: Diagnostics conformance case
description: One case. Three kinds, because the specification has three separable assertions: encoding a value (encode), reading a line (parse), and the level ordering (level). A runner reads `kind` and dispatches.

event.description: encode only. The candidate event. Deliberately unconstrained: most cases assert a malformed value is refused. A string-valued member (extensionId, in practice) MAY instead be a #/definitions/textLike descriptor, when the case needs a value too large to inline literally — the runner expands it into the literal string before the input reaches encodeDiagnostic. Keeping this property schema-unconstrained rather than switching it to a typed object is what still lets a case pass null, an array, or any other malformed shape here.

line.description: parse only. One decoded line, without its terminating LF. A string rather than a parsed object, because what is under test is the parsing.

level.description: level only. A plain string, not the four-value enum: meetsLevel is documented as total over an unpublished level in either argument position (spec §6), and an enum here would make that behavior structurally unpinnable.

threshold.description: level only, on the same terms as level.

line.description: encode only, on success: the exact canonical line — literal, or generated via #/definitions/textLike for a case whose extensionId is itself generated.

event.description: parse only, on success: the decoded event, without `nimbus`.

path.description: On refusal: the JSON Pointer naming the offending member.

utf8.description: Repeat this string's UTF-8 encoding, count times.

repeat.description: Generated content, so a case at the IPC_MAX_LINE_BYTES limit costs a few lines rather than a megabyte of literal characters in git. Mirrors docs/spec/conformance/v1/framing/case.schema.json's repeat descriptor, narrowed to the utf8 variant: a diagnostic event's string members are JSON text, not transport octets, so there is no byte-vs-character distinction to preserve here the way framing's chunk/frame vocabulary needs one.

oneOf.description: One string built from several parts, joined in order — used when a generated value sits inside fixed surrounding text, such as the canonical line around a generated extensionId.

textLike.description: A string, present literally, generated via #/definitions/repeat, or assembled from several such parts via concat. The runner resolves any of these three shapes to the same plain string before comparison.
